facts.fact: On 25 August 2026 the vice-president of government agreed that ANINF, the state agency that designed the Fichier unique de référence (FUR), would help fix its coding failures; the application has been operational for about twenty years.
ANINF, the national digital infrastructure agency, designed the FUR application that the public service ministry uses to manage the state's human resources.
